title: AI Productivity
description:
These classes teach you how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude to create content faster, analyze data easily, and write powerful marketing copy.

You’ll learn how to build Facebook content strategies, generate 10-day calendars, write engaging posts, and organize your workflow.

You’ll also learn how to turn raw social media numbers into clear reports and insights.

Finally, you’ll learn how to write ads, emails, captions, landing pages, and slogans using AI — and use emotion to make your content more persuasive.

title: VA Masterclass Kenya
description:
Learn how to become a professional Virtual Assistant in 5 days — even if you're starting from zero. This course teaches you how to package your services, use AI to work faster, create content for clients, build a portfolio, find clients, and deliver results with confidence.

Perfect for beginners, freelancers, and anyone looking for remote work or extra income.

title: Canva Masterclass
description: Design isn’t about expensive software — it’s about creativity, clarity, and execution. And with Canva, you can create professional-level designs in minutes — even without any graphic design background.

title: Getting started as a virtual assistant
description: A practical beginner-friendly masterclass that teaches you how to start, package, price, and grow a profitable Virtual Assistant business from Kenya or anywhere in Africa using simple digital skills and free tools. Learn what VAs do, the services you can offer, how to find clients, and how to deliver professional work with systems, templates, and AI tools. Perfect for anyone who wants to earn online with real, practical skills.

title: MODULE 1: Introduction to Social Media Management
description:
This module lays the foundation for everything you’ll do as a modern social media manager. You’ll understand what the role really involves, the skills businesses expect today, and how social platforms actually work in 2025. We break down the entire landscape — from the types of clients you’ll work with to the income opportunities available in Kenya, Africa, and globally.

You’ll also learn how social media has evolved from simple posting to a results-driven profession that requires strategy, creativity, and smart systems. Most importantly, we introduce how AI now fits into the workflow, helping you work faster, save time, and deliver more value to clients.

By the end of this module, you’ll have a clear understanding of what social media management is, what it is not, and how you can build a real career from it — even if you’re starting with no experience.

title: The Skill-to-Income Blueprint
description: A practical curriculum that teaches you how to turn your skills into income by understanding how online money really works.

title: Meta Ads Mastery: From Setup to Sales
description:
This curriculum teaches learners how to plan, launch, and manage effective Meta (Facebook & Instagram) ads with clarity and confidence.

It covers the Meta Ads ecosystem, campaign structure, objectives, and algorithm basics, then moves into practical execution for both product-based and service-based ads. Learners are guided through creative design, ad copywriting, audience targeting, budgeting using CAC, and lead generation through WhatsApp and landing pages.

The curriculum is practical, structured, and reinforced with quizzes and a final assessment. By the end, learners are equipped to confidently run Meta Ads campaigns for their own businesses or clients.

title: Build Your First Website Using AI
description: This short, practical course shows you how to design and publish a modern website using AI tools — without coding or complex software. You’ll learn how to plan, build, and launch a real website using ChatGPT and Lovable, following a clear, beginner-friendly process from start to finish. Perfect for anyone who wants fast, usable web design skills they can apply immediately.

title: The 5AM Productivity System
description: The 5AM Productivity System is a practical course designed to help learners build structure, focus, and consistency in their daily lives.

title: AI Productivity & Digital Workflows
description: This section teaches you how to use AI tools to work faster, think clearer, and produce better results in content creation, data analysis, copywriting, and digital tasks. You will learn practical workflows using ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Lovable to solve real problems, automate repetitive work, and deliver professional output without technical complexity.

title: Computer & Digital Skills — Complete Foundation
description: This curriculum takes you from absolute beginner to digitally confident in 14 structured lessons. You'll start with understanding what a computer really is, then build practical skills in Windows navigation, file management, and everyday shortcuts. From there, you'll master the full Google Workspace — Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Gmail — learning to create, collaborate, and communicate professionally. The course finishes with modern tools that give you an edge: ChatGPT for productivity, Canva for graphic design, and essential online safety practices. Every lesson is practical, step-by-step, and designed for people who feel left behind by technology.
